summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K announcing the redemption of its $575.0 million aggregate principal amount of 2.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028, triggered by its stock price exceeding 130% of the conversion price for 20 trading days. The redemption date is May 6, 2026, with a redemption price of 100% of principal plus accrued interest (~$1,002.19 per $1,000 principal). Holders may convert notes until May 4, 2026, at an increased conversion rate of 6.3232 ordinary shares per $1,000 principal during the make-whole period. This is a routine mandatory redemption of convertible notes, not a special situation.
